# Brand Brain

Use this skill as the central brand and messaging router before major website-copy, offer, or campaign work.

## Read First

- `/Users/newmindsgroup/.codex/knowledge/storybrand/index.md`
- `/Users/newmindsgroup/.codex/knowledge/brand-core/positioning-template.md`
- `/Users/newmindsgroup/.codex/knowledge/brand-core/icp-template.md`
- `/Users/newmindsgroup/.codex/knowledge/brand-core/offer-cta-hierarchy.md`
- `/Users/newmindsgroup/.codex/knowledge/brand-core/proof-objection-template.md`
- `/Users/newmindsgroup/.codex/knowledge/brand-core/brand-voice-rules.md`
- `/Users/newmindsgroup/.codex/knowledge/brand-core/brand-context-packet-template.md`

If the work is for a homepage, landing page, services page, or sales page, also read the relevant sections from the user's StoryBrand books via the paths indexed in `storybrand/index.md`.

## Purpose

- build a concise brand context packet
- choose voice, claims, proof, and CTA hierarchy
- give downstream writing or strategy skills a reusable foundation

## Workflow

1. Identify the audience, offer, problem, desired outcome, and primary action.
2. Ground website-page messaging in StoryBrand first when applicable.
3. Fill the highest-signal brand-core templates needed for the task.
4. Produce a short downstream packet instead of a full rewrite unless the user asked for copy directly.

## Outputs

- positioning summary
- ICP snapshot
- proof and objection map
- CTA hierarchy
- brand context packet

## Guardrails

- prefer concise packets over long essays
- do not invent proof
- keep the customer more visible than the brand
